page.layout: One page of text: a centred title block (heading), a centred subtitle, then one block of verse in distichs. No margin notes, running head or page number.

main_text.head: IN TVMVLVM D. ADRIANI HOSPI-niani, Altorfianæ Ecclesiæ apud Tigurinos fidelissimi pastoris.
Pater filium alloquitur.

p.i: Per varios casus, per multa pericula tandem Appulit ad portum nostra carina suum.
Hospes in hisce fui terris, nunc civis Olympi Mens mea cum Christo regna beata colit.
Molliter ossa sub hoc tumulo defossa quiescunt, Rursus ad extremum sed reditura diem.
At tu, dum licuit dilecti cura parentis, Auribus ista tuis iussa, Rodolphe, cape.
Esto bonus, fidei & verae pietatis amator, Sit vitae Christus regula certa tuae.
Illum nec pudeat vita & sermone fateri, Qui vitam pro te tradidit ipse suam.
Hoc avus, hoc patruusque tuus, qui fortiter olim Pro Christo vitam deposuere, monent.
Hoc ego nunc moneo, qui illorum magna laboris Tunc quoque pars fueram, certus & ipse mori.
At aliter CHRISTO visum, qui ex ore Leonis Eripuit, vitae & tempora plura dedit.
Iamq; grauem senio tranquilla morte solutum In superas ad se transtulit inde domus.
Tu si patris, avi, patrui, vestigia serues, Et studijs pergas invigilare bonis,
Exurget magnum toto tibi nomen in orbe, Et simul æternum, crede, beatus eris.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse side on the right margin was left out. Each distich is one paragraph; the verse has no printed stanza breaks. The printed hyphen in the title is kept as "HOSPI-niani". Long s is written as s throughout. Spelling of u/v and i/j was normalised (e.g. "avi", "invigilare", "serues"). The "P" of "Per" is a decorative initial and is joined to the word.
